ApiKeySaved: Key saved. You can dictate without restarting.
ApiKeyFromEnvironment: Using a key from an environment variable or .env. A key saved here takes precedence.
ApiKeyMissing: No key configured. Paste it and click Save key.
ApiKeyReadError: Could not read the saved key. Save it again.
InvalidApiKey: Enter a key without spaces or line breaks.
RecordingHint: Hold the recording shortcut. Release it to insert text into the active field. Esc cancels recording.
MicrophoneMissing: No microphone found. Check microphone access in your system settings.
DeviceCannotRecord: The selected device cannot record audio.
AudioQueueFull: Could not save audio fast enough.
RecordingError: Microphone recording failed. Audio has been saved.
MicrophoneStopped: The microphone stopped recording. Check the selected device.
MicrophoneTimeout: No sound received. Check your microphone connection, mute setting and microphone access in system settings.
MissingApiKey: Add your Gemini key in Settings.
ApiKeyNotFound: Add your Gemini key in Settings.
NoSpeechRecorded: No speech recorded. Check your microphone.
NetworkError: Cannot connect to Gemini. Audio has been saved.
TranscriptionError: Transcription failed. Audio has been saved for retry.
DifferentShortcuts: Recording and history need different shortcuts.
InvalidModel: Enter a valid Gemini model name.
InvalidLanguage: Choose System default, English or Russian.
GeminiBadRequest: Gemini rejected the request. Check your model and API key.
GeminiUnauthorized: Gemini: invalid API key or no access to this model.
GeminiModelMissing: Gemini: model not found. Choose another model in Settings.
GeminiRateLimit: Gemini: request limit reached. Try again later.
GeminiEmpty: Gemini returned no transcription. Audio has been saved for retry.
GeminiTruncated: Gemini's response was truncated. Retry with a shorter recording.
GeminiFailed: Gemini could not transcribe this recording.
SavedAudioHint: Audio has been saved. You can retry transcription.
PortAudioMissing: PortAudio was not found. Rebuild the application.
HotkeyOneKey: Use one key with optional Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win modifiers.
HotkeyNeedsModifier: Add Ctrl, Alt or Win for letters, numbers or Space.
WaylandLimitation: Wayland: use the Record button and history. Global hotkeys and automatic paste require X11.
X11Unavailable: Cannot connect to X11. Use the Record button and copy from history.
PasteRequiresX11: Automatic paste requires an X11 session.
X11PasteFailed: X11 could not send paste keystrokes.
MacLimitation: macOS: allow Microphone and Accessibility access. Hotkeys are observed without suppressing the original key; function keys may require Fn.
MacAccessibility: Allow Accessibility access for Govori in macOS Settings.
MacUnsupportedKey: This key is not supported on macOS.
PasteBlocked: Windows blocked paste. Copy text from history. To paste into an elevated application, run Govori as administrator.
History.own_window: Saved to history — copy the text
History.keys_held: Saved to history — shortcut keys are still held
History.target_changed: Saved to history — active window changed
History.target_changed_clipboard: Saved to history and clipboard — active window changed
